arms.P_R/Z_R: per-slice residual arm (four scores residualised on the slice's density arm inside each outer training fold), protocol refit / standardized residuals; gate: P_R equals density_adds.npz's R arm for every seed
arms.P_PC1/Z_PC1, P_PC24/Z_PC24: combined PC1 of every slice / PCs 2-4 of every slice, protocol refit / standardized; gate: equal to P1/P24 for every seed

indicator: share of fitted folds whose chosen C is the grid's top (1e4)
intervals: paired bootstrap over slides of seed-averaged per-slide values, shared indices default_rng(12345).integers(0, 123, (4000, 123)); scaling: Z - P (accuracy), P - Z (log-loss); res_chance: Z_R - chance; res_ll: prevalence - Z_R (log-loss); pc1/pc24: Z_PC - Z_density_all of scaled_section7.npz (accuracy), Z_density_all - Z_PC (log-loss)
